SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM satscores st
    WHERE st.cds = s.CDSCode
    AND st.NumGE1500 >= 1
);

SELECT s.School 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM satscores st
    WHERE st.cds = s.CDSCode
    AND st.NumGE1500 >= 1
);

SELECT s.School 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM satscores st
    WHERE st.cds = s.CDSCode
    AND st.NumGE1500 > 0
);

SELECT DISTINCT s.School 
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sa ON f.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 AND sa.NumGE1500 >= 1;

SELECT s.School 
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sa ON f.CDSCode = SUBSTR(sa.cds, 4)
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 AND sa.NumGE1500 >= 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 AND s.NumGE1500 >= 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
AND s.NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT s2.NCESSchool
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN satscores sa ON s2.CDSCode = sa.cds
    WHERE sa.NumGE1500 >= 1
);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
AND s.CDSCode IN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 >= 1
);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND s.[NumGE1500] >= 1500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND s.[NumGE1500] >= 1500;

SELECT s.School
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND s.NCESDist IN (
    SELECT d.NCESDist
    FROM satscores d
    WHERE d.NumGE1500 >= 1500
);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] > 0.1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM satscores st
    WHERE st.cds = s.CDSCode
    AND st.NumGE1500 >= 1500
);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND s.NCESDist IN (
    SELECT d.NCESDist
    FROM satscores st
    JOIN schools d ON st.cds = d.CDSCode
    WHERE st.NumGE1500 >= 1500
);

SELECT s.School
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND s.NCESDist IN (
    SELECT NCESDist
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY NCESDist
    HAVING MAX(AvgScrMath) >= 1500
);
